name: Sapphire Snowe: The Bear, The Beast & The Blizzard
source:
After a devastating diagnosis, a suicidal Sapphire wanders into the wintery woodland near her home, hoping to disappear.

She only wanted to escape, but a chance encounter with an elemental sends Saffie on a different path entirely as she finds herself trapped in the snowy wilderness.

Help Saffie escape the blizzard and perhaps find peace and more along the way.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/sapphire-snowe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
得知晴天霹雳般的诊断结果后，心生轻生之念的萨菲尔独自步入自家附近的冬日林地，只盼就此消失无踪。

她原本只想一走了之，然而与一名元素精灵的偶然邂逅，却将困于苍茫雪原之中的萨菲推上了一条截然不同的道路。

帮助萨菲逃离暴风雪，说不定还能在途中觅得内心的平静与更多珍贵之物。

[摘自[url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/sapphire-snowe]itch.io[/url]]
